metadata.method: Static parsing of enum allowedNextStates and transition_costs.txt; no Java compilation or robot execution. Explicitly accounts for GROUND_ALGAE_INTAKE fall-through.
metadata.caveat: Nominal state wrist angles shown. CLEAR_ELEVATOR_CROSSBEAM dynamically chooses/clamps wrist angle -90..-80 degrees from final desired state. Edges are allowed transitions, not proof of physical collision safety. All generated collision flags are false. This file does not apply runtime algae/manual-mode blocking.
